risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-value PS4 variant (worst case for value).

risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only 1 controller is included (worst case vs the seller’s claim).

risks.risk: Pre-installed games and the specific titles (FIFA 27, PES 27, GTA...) are not verifiable from photos.
risks.proof: A photo/video of the PS4 home screen showing the installed games list (or Settings/Library showing installed titles).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (no guaranteed games).

risks.risk: Functionality is unknown (disc drive, HDMI output, Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth, controller buttons/analog sticks).
risks.proof: Short video showing the console powering on to the home screen and the controller working (moving cursor + pressing buttons).

risks.proof: Photos of the back ports and included accessories (power cable/HDMI) laid out.

Photo showing all included controllers (count clearly visible).

response.reason: The photos confirm a PS4-looking console and at least one controller, but the key parts that determine price in Oyo (exact PS4 variant, number of pads, and installed games/titles, plus working condition) are not verifiable remotely from the provided images.
